newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: United Drug says profit rose in all sectors.
newsitem.headline: United Drug says profit rose in all sectors.

text.p: United Drug Plc said on Tuesday that its three divisions -- pharmaceutical, consumer products and medical and scientific -- reported increases in turnover and profits in the year to September 30, 1996.

The pharmaceutical distribution group said an improvement in the mix of turnover between the three divisions enabled operating profit margins to increase to 2.71 percent from 2.62 percent a year earlier.
The group announced an overall increase of 19 percent in pre-tax profit to 6.0 million punts with turnover rising in both its Republic of Ireland and Northern Ireland operations.
Within the pharmaceutical division, United Drug Wholesale reported market share gains with retail sales increasing by almost 13 percent against pharmaceutical retail market growth of 11 percent.
Sales to hospitals increased by 14 percent while an improvement was again recorded in the operating expenses to sales ratio.
"Combined, all these factors place this business in a very advantageous competetive positiion in its marketplace," the company said in a statement.

In the consumer products division, profits reported by Pemberton Marketing in the first half of 1996 continued into the second half of the year due to focused brand and business development and good cost control management, United Drug said.

The agency for Johnson & Johnson, including the Neutrogena brand, was awarded to the OTC business area while both the cosmetics and photographic areas performed in line with, or exceeded their respective market segments.

The medical and scientific division consolidated its position as a leading player in the Irish market with the full intergration of Novapath Supplies and Vector Sceintific, acquired in 1995, into the existing business of Unitech in Dublin and Ulster Anaesthetics in Belfast.
"The combination of these businesses enabled the division achieve substantial economies of scale which, combined with good sales growth, translated into strong profit growth," the company said.
